description: Search sound effects in English or Vietnamese by source and measured traits, such as sharp attack, long tail or wide stereo. Each result has a description, a preview and download links. Use get_sfx for the checksum and file details. For a hit under speech, pass duration tick or short. lufs is null when a sound is too short to measure. guide says how to choose among these results and what to call next.

duration.description: tick is under 0.5 s, short 0.5 to 2 s, medium 2 to 5 s, long 5 s and over

offset.description: Skip this many results to see the next page

name: search_sfx
